title: Hypertrophy PPL
author: Cruz K.
desc: High Volume PPL 6x/week program focused on Hypertrophy. Every major muscle is hit 10+ times per week. Forearms and calves are done daily. Every set is close to failure excluding your warmup sets / stretching etc... This is not a strength program. Not recommended for athletes in-season.
